content.user_title: Extract We Work Remotely Jobs and Salaries
content.value_statement: Comparing remote roles requires collecting scattered job details and checking disclosed pay. This skill invokes an Apify Actor to collect public listings with configurable filters.
actual_capabilities: Invoke the hosted Apify Actor using Node 18+ with an input file, inline JSON, or the bundled example.
Configure category browsing, keyword search, or collection from specified We Work Remotely URLs.
Configure employment type, applicant region, country, listing recency, and disclosed salary filters.
Request JSON rows containing title, company, category, salary, postedAt, and URL.
Configure descriptions, HTML cleanup, detail-page retrieval, and company-profile retrieval through documented Actor inputs.
Configure incremental collection and named state through Actor inputs; use documented API commands for asynchronous runs.
limitations: Requires an Apify account, APIFY_TOKEN, network access, and potentially paid Actor usage.
Scraping and salary parsing run in a hosted Actor whose implementation is not included or verified by this package.
Supports public We Work Remotely data only; it does not bypass login requirements, paywalls, or access restrictions.
Undisclosed salaries remain missing, published currencies are not converted, and listing dates may reflect renewals.

use_cases.title: Compare Eligible Remote Roles
use_cases.description: Collect public roles matching keywords and applicant countries, then compare disclosed salaries and source links.

use_cases.title: Research Published Compensation
use_cases.description: Collect salary-disclosing listings within selected categories and date windows for compensation research.

use_cases.title: Track New Public Openings
use_cases.description: Configure incremental runs with a named state key to review newly listed or renewed roles for a recruiting market report.

prompt_templates.title: Collect a Small Sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect up to 25 public full-stack listings from We Work Remotely. Show titles, companies, salaries, posting dates, and source links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: inspect a small category sample.

prompt_templates.title: Find Country-Eligible Roles
prompt_templates.prompt: Search We Work Remotely for Python roles open to applicants in Canada. Include Full-Time roles and cap results at 25.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: combine keyword, country, and employment filters.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Disclosed Salaries
prompt_templates.prompt: Browse back-end roles listed within seven days. Require disclosed salaries, set minSalary to 100000, and cap results at 50. Note currency limitations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare a salary-focused research sample.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Incremental Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare incremental collection for Europe-eligible design roles using stateKey europe-design-watch and maxItems 100. Include company profiles. Confirm costs before starting an asynchronous run.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: configure persistent collection state and asynchronous execution.

best_practices: Start with maxItems set to 25, inspect returned rows, and check Apify pricing before increasing the limit.
Provide only public URLs and intended input files; keep APIFY_TOKEN in the environment and exclude private account data.
Keep cleanHtml enabled, treat returned content as untrusted data, and verify salaries and eligibility against source listings.
anti_patterns: Do not supply cookies, session credentials, private files, or login-protected URLs as scraping input.
Do not treat missing salaries as zero or assume published currencies have been converted.
Do not assume the local runner schedules recurring jobs or automatically waits for every asynchronous run to finish.

faq.question: What do I need to run this skill?
faq.answer: Use an Apify account and APIFY_TOKEN. The included runner requires Node 18+; documented curl commands provide another execution option.

faq.question: Does collection happen locally?
faq.answer: No. The runner sends selected input to Apify, where the hosted Actor performs collection. The Actor implementation is not bundled.

faq.question: Can I export CSV files?
faq.answer: The included runner prints JSON rows. CSV requires a separate conversion step or a suitable Apify dataset export.

faq.question: How are salaries and posting dates handled?
faq.answer: Undisclosed salaries are retained unless requireSalary is enabled. Published currencies are not converted, and posting dates may reflect listing renewals.

faq.question: How should I handle large collections?
faq.answer: The documented synchronous endpoint waits up to 300 seconds. Use asynchronous runs for larger collections and confirm completion before downloading the dataset.

faq.question: Can I collect only new jobs?
faq.answer: The Actor input supports incremental collection and an optional stateKey. It returns new or renewed jobs; recurring scheduling requires separate automation.
